thread:
Priya: Received an alert from Nimbus this morning. They're seeing duplicate billable minutes for customers around DST cutover. Example: customer nimbus-cust-42 shows +60m in both 02:00 and 03:00 hour windows. Ticket: https://nimbus.inc/1234
Leo: likely overlap in ingest windowing. Do they send local timestamps or UTC?
Priya: they send local tz in payload and our ingest code uses rollup by hour_of_local_time. that breaks on fall-back (clock moves back 1h).
Carmen: ouch. we should canonicalize all ingestion to UTC epoch and bucket by floor_ts(3600). we do that elsewhere though?
Leo: current pipeline has two codepaths: realtime webhook (uses partner_tz header) and batch replay (normalized). inconsistent behavior between them.
Priya: Nimbus says they can't change their exporter quickly. short-term fix on our side?
Carmen: plan: 1) convert incoming timestamps to UTC and compute an ingestion_window_id = concat(customer_id, floor_ts_utc) for dedupe. 2) if we detect two different local hour buckets that map to same UTC window, dedupe by event_id and sum only unique records.
Leo: technical caveat: some partners send no event_id (older SDK). we need fallback: compute event_fingerprint = sha256(customer_id + ts + payload_hash) and treat that as id for dedupe.
Priya: how many affected customers estimate? billing-bot: query queued: SELECT partner, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM marketplace_usage WHERE partner = 'nimbus' AND date >= '2025-10-25' AND (local_hour_overlap_flag = true) GROUP BY partner; estimated rows: 1 in result set, approx customers: 128
Carmen: OK. Next: we should not change historical billed amounts automatically. propose: mark overlapping windows as "review_needed" and surface them in partner-ops dashboard. run a manual reconciliation for top 20 customers and offer credit adjustments if confirmed duplicates.
Leo: agree. add a signal to the alerting tier: if duplicates >0.5% of partner hourly windows, auto-open SOC ticket and CC partnerships.
Priya: Nimbus asked about contract language: they want a clause for timezone-related dedupe cutover. Jordan from legal needs to draft minimal amendment allowing us to de-duplicate overlaps when root cause is timezone export. Carmen: I'll take a first pass with sample clause.
Carmen: sample clause draft in chat: "Partner agrees that Redwood may normalize timestamps to UTC for billing purposes and perform de-duplication of overlapping hourly windows resulting from timezone transitions; adjustments will be handled via billing reconciliation and mutually agreed credits." thoughts?
Priya: good start. Nimbus also asks for a replay endpoint for customers to resubmit raw events if they find gaps. can we expose a signed replay URL for 14 days?
Leo: yes. Security note: require HMAC signature v2 + nonce. Also limit replay acceptance to events where event_ts within 30 days.
Priya: operational tasks: Carmen implement dedupe id + alert; Leo update webhook docs and add fingerprint fallback; billing-bot generate customer list and open reconciliation queue; Priya draft partner comms + legal clause.
billing-bot: Action items recorded: ["Carmen: dedupe id + dashboard","Leo: webhook docs + fingerprint fallback","billing-bot: customer list for Nimbus","Priya: partner comms + contract ask"]
Priya: timeline? aim for hotfix next week (no code that touches invoicing), and a full rollout with reconciliation two weeks after. Nimbus wants updates daily until resolved.
Nimbus-bot: automated note: Nimbus acknowledged the plan and requested daily status emails to nimbus-infra@partners.nimbus.com :email:
Priya: thanks team. I'll start the partner update and schedule a sync with Nimbus ops for tomorrow 09:30 PT.
